name: Executive Roofing Systems
what_they_do: Commercial roofing contractor doing single-ply/flat-roof repair, replacement, inspection, new-construction roofing, 24/7 emergency leak response and preventative maintenance across New Jersey and the tri-state area. Certified with GAF, Firestone and Versico and an NRCA member, per the partner logos on the site.
customers: Commercial building owners, property managers, facility managers and general contractors - not homeowners. Service area list covers ~379 New Jersey towns plus NY/CT.

size_signals.signal: Six distinct service pages plus careers and gallery pages, GAF/Firestone/Versico certifier logos, NRCA membership, LinkedIn and Google Business presence
Locations page lists several hundred New Jersey towns served - a multi-crew regional operation rather than a two-man shop (inference from service-area scale)
Birdeye profile aggregating 86 customer reviews for the business

listing.platform: Google (aggregated on Birdeye); GAF contractor listing also rated 4.7 from 74 reviews

website_review.primary_cta: 'Get Pricing' / 'Get A Fast Quote' (scrolls to a consultation form) plus a 'Click to Call' button in the hero
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Three on-page forms (short contact, 'Request Consultation' with name/company/email/phone/building address/message, and a 'Service Needed?' version); all reCAPTCHA-protected; 'Make an Appointment' link points at the contact page, no real calendar
website_review.trust_signals: Manufacturer certifications (GAF, Versico, Firestone), NRCA member badge, project gallery, testimonials section, service pages, LinkedIn feed, 24/7 emergency line
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Address on the live site is 316 Tennent Rd, Suite 102, Morganville NJ 07751 - not the Spotswood address in the batch record; the site shows a BBB badge image, and the BBB profile (behind a bot check) could not be verified
website_review.search_basics: Titles and descriptions are service-focused ('Top Rated Commercial Roofing Contractor in New Jersey') but push the state rather than Spotswood/Morganville; each service has its own page; town-level coverage is a single long link list, not town pages
top_issues: Structured data stops at Organization - no LocalBusiness/RoofingContractor record with address, hours, geo or priceRange even though hours (Mon-Fri 9-5) and the address are on the page
Every quote path ends in a reCAPTCHA-protected form; no calendar booking despite a 'Make an Appointment' link
Primary listing/NAP conflict: site says Morganville, the directory record says 1 American Way, Spotswood
Service-area page is a 379-town keyword list - readable, but thin per town and not backed by any local content

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt is a Yoast default that allows everything (OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot/Googlebot not blocked), Yoast sitemap present, Google Business presence referenced on the site and 86 reviews aggregated. Answerable: services, service area, address, phone and hours (Mon-Fri 9-5) all exist as real text, and each service has its own page - but the JSON-LD @graph has only WebPage/ImageObject/BreadcrumbList/WebSite/Organization, with no address, hours or priceRange in the Organization node, and no published price ranges. Bookable: labelled forms (Your Name, Phone, Email, Service Needed?) and click-to-call work, but reCAPTCHA and the absence of scheduling make a fully agent-driven quote impossible.

operations_signals.signal: 24/7 emergency leak response offering implies after-hours calls that must be triaged by a human team
'Takes only 10 seconds to request' quote widget plus three separate forms = multiple unconnected intake channels to reconcile
Open careers page - crews are being hired, which usually means office/estimating staff are the bottleneck too (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Quote-intake and triage agent: normalise the three forms, ask building/roof-type and urgency questions, schedule site visits, and hand sales a priced-scope summary - plus remove the CAPTCHA from the agent path
top_opportunities.evidence: Three separate forms (one with 'Service Needed?'), all reCAPTCHA-gated, no calendar, and a 24/7 emergency line to triage

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness/RoofingContractor JSON-LD with address, hours, geo, areaServed and service list, and reconcile the Spotswood vs Morganville NAP across directory listings
top_opportunities.evidence: JSON-LD @graph contains only WebPage/WebSite/Organization with no address or hours; site address differs from the directory record

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the 379-town link list with a handful of county/Middlesex-area pages that carry real project photos and named towns, and keep publishing the gallery/blog
top_opportunities.evidence: Locations page is a bare alphabetical town list with no per-town content or case studies

scores.reasons: Gap: this is the most mature site in the batch - service pages, certifications, CTA and click-to-call all present; the gaps are schema depth, CAPTCHA and NAP/listing hygiene. Pay: commercial roofer with a multi-state service area and hiring activity, so contract values in the tens of thousands. Ease: schema and NAP work is quick, but process automation needs their sales input. Evidence: site, forms, JSON-LD types and hours all inspected directly.
